description: Genus-2 (biweight) enumerator of a putative Type II [72,36,16] code. Uniquely forced: genus-2 MacWilliams self-equation plus the unique genus-1 Gleason marginal pins all 1177 pair-count coefficients N(wu,wv,t) to a unique nonnegative integer solution (all-positive, consistent with the code). Computed by biweight_genus2_macwilliams.sage; validated on [8,4,4].

computation.method: G-orbit-reduced genus-2 MacWilliams self-equation over ZZ
computation.note: The solved orbit values are cached in biweight_genus2_cols.pkl. To extract them, load the pkl, construct the matrix, and solve the rank-179 system over QQ with normalization (orbit with (72,0,0,0)) = 1.
